links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses on glaucoma surgery for patients
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease Score was 57.6 for Google Bard and 22.6 for ChatGPT; ChatGPT-3.5 had 66% and 82% of sentences over 30 and 20 syllables vs Bard 23% and 52%.
links.quote: For example, the Flesch Reading Ease Score was 57.6 for Google Bard and 22.6 for ChatGPT, indicating Google Bard's content is easier to read.

links.outcome: Appropriateness of LLM glaucoma surgical answers graded by glaucoma specialists
links.effect: Appropriate answers in 68% of Google Bard responses and 96% of ChatGPT-3.5 responses.
links.quote: Appropriate answers to the posed questions were obtained in 68% of the responses with Google Bard and 96% with ChatGPT-3.5.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline appropriateness and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 and Google Bard in answering patient questions about glaucoma surgery, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
